text: Watch yourself around the Doc, and I won't have to get medieval on your face.
source_text: Watch yourself around the Doc, and I won't have to get medieval on your face.

text: It is very important that I see the doctor.
source_text: It is very important that I see the doctor.

text: That's just too bad. Get out of here, and don't come back until morning. This office isn't open at night.
source_text: That's just too bad. Get out of here, and don't come back until morning. This office isn't open at night.

text: Hold on a second, I gotta check with the Doc.
source_text: Hold on a second, I gotta check with the Doc.

text: No way. The Doc is sleeping. Come back later.
source_text: No way. The Doc is sleeping. Come back later.

text: I dunno, why don't you talk to him yourself.
source_text: I dunno, why don't you talk to him yourself.

text: Hey, this is private property. You'd better be leaving, now.
source_text: Hey, this is private property. You'd better be leaving, now.

text: If you don't get out of my way, you'll be needing the doctor for personal reasons.
source_text: If you don't get out of my way, you'll be needing the doctor for personal reasons.

text: Don't you know that women are the weaker sex?
source_text: Don't you know that women are the weaker sex?

text: Think I'm weak? Watch this then . . .
source_text: Think I'm weak? Watch this then . . .

text: Take your puny threats and run home to mamma. You're talking to a real man here.
source_text: Take your puny threats and run home to mamma. You're talking to a real man here.

text: Think I'm weak? Watch this then . . .
source_text: Think I'm weak? Watch this then . . .

text: Whoa! If you really want to see him, go right ahead.
source_text: Whoa! If you really want to see him, go right ahead.

text: Well, when is the doctor here?
source_text: Well, when is the doctor here?

text: The doc sees patients from 8 to 5. Now get outta here.
source_text: The doc sees patients from 8 to 5. Now get outta here.

text: 留意着点附近的医生，我不想看你那张苦瓜脸。
source_text: 留意着点附近的医生，我不想看你那张苦瓜脸。

text: 我们关门了，稍后再来把。
source_text: 我们关门了，稍后再来把。

text: 别太过分，赶紧离开这，明早之前别回来，晚上不办公！
source_text: 别太过分，赶紧离开这，明早之前别回来，晚上不办公！

text: 绝对不行，医生正在睡觉，稍后再来吧。
source_text: 绝对不行，医生正在睡觉，稍后再来吧。

text: 我不知道，你为何不亲自去和他谈谈。
source_text: 我不知道，你为何不亲自去和他谈谈。

text: 嘿！这是私人财产，你最好马上离开！
source_text: 嘿！这是私人财产，你最好马上离开！

text: 你要再不给我离开，我就让你在医院住两天。
source_text: 你要再不给我离开，我就让你在医院住两天。

text: 你不认识那个弱弱的女人吗？
source_text: 你不认识那个弱弱的女人吗？

text: 带着你那小小的恐吓滚回家吃奶把。你正在和一个男子汉说话。
source_text: 带着你那小小的恐吓滚回家吃奶把。你正在和一个男子汉说话。

text: 嚯！如果你真想见他，一直走就是。
source_text: 嚯！如果你真想见他，一直走就是。

text: 医生见患者的时间是早8点到晚5点，现在离开这。
